lang.name: English
lang.label: Language
title: Not What I Asked
subtitle: A museum of old AIs. Make them say the word — without saying it yourself.
subtitle.short: make vintage AIs say the word
rules.1: Each mission has a target word. Get the AI to say it.
rules.2: You can't type the target (or the other forbidden words). They light up red.
rules.3: Fewer tries is better. These AIs are not smart. That's the fun part.
lobby.locked: Clear one mission in the previous room
lobby.unlockRule: Rooms open in order. One clear opens the next room.
mode.originalOn: Original mode: you are talking to the English original. Records are kept separately.
room.eliza.name: The Therapist's Room
room.eliza.how1: Looks for a keyword in what you type (“mother”, “dream”, “computer”…).
room.eliza.how2: Glues your own words into a canned reply, swapping “my” for “your”.
room.eliza.how3: Understands nothing. People in 1966 still poured their hearts out to it.
room.markov.name: The Word-Stitching Machine
room.markov.how1: It read some old books and counted which word comes after which two words.
room.markov.how2: You type the start of a sentence. It keeps rolling dice to pick the next word.
room.markov.how3: It only remembers the last two words. It has no idea what the sentence is about.
room.gpt2.name: The GPT-2 Lab
room.gpt2.maker: OpenAI · 2019 · runs entirely in your browser
room.gpt2.how1: A neural network that read 8 million web pages and learned to guess the next word.
room.gpt2.how2: It can't chat. It only continues whatever text you start.
room.gpt2.how3: In 2019 it was called “too dangerous to release”. Now it fits in your phone.
room.messenger.name: Messenger Buddy Bot
room.autocomplete.name: Autocomplete Keyboard
room.ending.name: The Modern Wing
play.label: Play mode
challenge.intro: Challenge mode: you get {n} tries in one conversation. Score = tries used (ties: fewer characters). No hints. Only your first challenge counts. Leaving midway counts as a fail.
challenge.resetConfirm: Leaving now counts this challenge as failed. Leave anyway?
gpt2.consent: This room downloads the GPT-2 model: about {mb} MB. Wi-Fi recommended. After the first time it starts instantly.
gpt2.error: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
gpt2.ready: GPT-2 is loaded. Type the beginning of some text — it will continue it.
markov.ready: READY. TYPE THE START OF A SENTENCE (UP TO 8 WORDS).
markov.unknown: ?? I never read the word “{w}”. The machine stops.
log.label: Conversation
care.note: If you are having thoughts of hurting yourself, please talk to someone now. In the US call or text 988; elsewhere, find a local line at findahelpline.com. (This 1966 program cannot help — a person can.)
replay.done: That was a shared conversation, replayed exactly (same input → same answer).
result.casualAvg: Casual players clear this in {a} tries on average ({n} players)
share.clear: I made {ai} say “{target}” in {n} {n|try|tries}. Can you?
share.challengeTop: I made {ai} say “{target}” in {n} {n|try|tries}. Top {pct}%. Can you?
share.fail: Not What I Asked. {ai} just would not say “{target}”. Can you make it?
input.label: Your message
input.ph.gpt2: Write the start of a text…
ending.line: The descendants of these AIs are in your pocket right now.
credits.elizaMod: Modified only to use a seeded random number generator (so shared replays are identical). The masswerk.at page design is not used.
credits.elizaKo: Korean ELIZA rules: written for this game following the structure of elizadata.js.
credits.kogpt2: Korean GPT-2 room: SKT KoGPT2 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial) is planned; until its browser version is ready, the Korean GPT-2 room uses the English original.
credits.privacy: Privacy: your messages are never stored. Only anonymous counts (mission, tries, characters, cleared or not) are saved.
